messages:
sam (AE): Hey team — onboarding one of our bigger customers, they want to split the PO across two org entities and push first milestone payment after go‑live. Need quick check: can we do a one MSA + amendment that allows split POs and two billing entities? nina (Legal): We can, but need an MSA amendment template. main risks: 1) payment default waterfall, 2) audit + invoice ownership, 3) signature authority on each PO. rahul (Sales-ops): Practically speaking we need both POs on the same orderform so billing system maps to the same contract id. Is that acceptable? tara (Procurement): Customer requires separate tax IDs on PO lines and wants net-60 on one and net-30 on the other. Also asking for an escrow clause for the first milestone. matt (Finance): Net-60 on one line increases DSO — we need approval. Also need the PO numbers before countersign. nina (Legal): Suggest amendment that: - explicitly allows multiple POs per Contract ID - ties billing lines to billing entity + tax ID - sets default payment priority (PO A before PO B) unless parties list otherwise - preserves SLA/KPI terms across both entities rahul (Sales-ops): Can we also include a short fallback: if second PO not received within 30 days, services continue but invoice moves to main entity? matt (Finance): Yes but need credit hold language and a 7-day notice before suspension. nina (Legal): I'll draft a minimal amendment and a short approval paragraph for the order form. Can someone post the exact order form fields the customer will fill? sam (AE): Pasting the customer's requested order form snippet:

```
Customer Entity A (billing): Acme Labs, TaxID: 12-3456789, PO: PO-A-2026
Customer Entity B (billing): Acme Platform, TaxID: 98-7654321, PO: PO-B-2026
Products: Redwood Hosted API (x2 models) - units by tokens
Start Date: 2026-05-01
Milestone 1: Go-live (50% of total) invoiced after go-live
Milestone 2: Production support (remaining 50%) quarterly
Payment terms: Net-60 (Entity A), Net-30 (Entity B)
SLA: 99.9% uptime, credit cap: 10% of monthly fees
Data: EU-residency preferred, DPA required
```

tara (Procurement): Also: they want countersign via their DocuSign, and legal wants an executed MSA + amendment before first milestone invoice. nina (Legal): OK — countersign via their platform is fine provided the executed PDF lands in our CLM and signatures are verifiable. rahul (Sales-ops): For routing: plan = 1) send MSA + amendment to customer legal, 2) get both signed, 3) customer returns both POs, 4) Sales-ops ingest both POs into billing system and attach to Contract ID. Any blockers? nina (Legal): One: DPA needs a EU data residency appendix. Two: SLA credits — customer wants linear credits up to 50% which we should cap. I'll propose capping credits at 10% and clarifying measurement windows. matt (Finance): Need to confirm tax treatment for split invoices — operations will need billing contacts for each entity. sam (AE): I've got billing contacts. Adding them in thread: @tara can you confirm we can accept two separate invoices against same contract id? tara (Procurement): We can if Sales-ops maps both to same contract and the amendment references both POs. rahul (Sales-ops): I'll prepare the ingestion checklist. Quick question: do we want to set automatic fallback that routes unpaid Entity B invoices to Entity A after 30 days? nina (Legal): We can do a fallback but better to keep it opt-in. I'll add language: "billing fallback only if both parties expressly agree in writing." matt (Finance): Prefer automatic fallback with notice; reduces revenue leakage. nina (Legal): Tradeoff noted. I'll present both options in the amendment: (A) opt-in fallback clause, (B) automatic fallback with 7-day final notice and credit hold. matt (Finance): Good. esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created by sam for MSA+Amendment -> envelope id: 0a1b2c3d, status: created (link: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a1b2c3d) :white_check_mark: sam (AE): Thanks — I'll route to customer legal now. nina (Legal): I'll draft amendment and DPA appendix, aim to share by EOD today. rahul (Sales-ops): Once docs are signed, I'll push to billing and ping finance for PO ingestion. tara (Procurement): I'll confirm acceptance of two invoices per contract with our AP team and confirm tax handling. sam (AE): Awesome — if we get signatures this week we can keep go-live on 2026-05-01. Calling this thread green for now :tada:
